history_review.reason: Reproduced SQL/result-publication defects and missing entry/refresh paths justify these specific changes; inherited C++ is implementation evidence, not publisher balance certification.

implemented: All four territory result writes run through the shared Map DB lane and apply their confirmed result on the actor before another event changes the participants.
Mission and Sky Garden adapters bind the SQL return value; rejected/throwing saves produce no successful ownership acknowledgement. Mission reward/state publication waits for SQL success.
Fort/castle result callbacks no longer run from independent Task.Run writes or wait for a later timer tick. The existing guild-board callback queue is retained for its separate consumers.
Castle reward dispatch and player stat experience wait for a successful occupation result. End-of-fight client notification still precedes SQL; the entire settlement is not atomic.
War stat rewards request the existing World guild-info response, which includes the character's stat fields. Stat/PvP rewards schedule the existing SQL character checkpoint.

Saved PCT_GUILD destinations are rechecked on admission and after castle capture. Former owners leave the guild house; mercenary allegiance does not grant house ownership. Missing return data denies entry without inventing coordinates.
Registered operator IDs receive the native castle-entry exception.
World waits for applicant SQL before changing a member/mercenary's slot or publishing assignment, withdrawal, movement and counts. A thrown SQL error leaves the old slot and actor remains usable.
Migration 044 scopes Sky Garden writes to wID and rejects missing mission/garden targets. Unknown existing procedure repairs are refused; both procedure alterations roll back together.

remaining.area: Durable SQL war settlement and reward delivery
remaining.detail: Accepted server reward letters now use Wolverine SQL transport and permanent native receipts, with atomic header/coins/items/receipt and World notification outbox (Gameforge/wolverine-mail.json). Still freeze the whole war result and every recipient under one durable operation identity, then recover occupation, player/guild points/stats and World publication with receipts. A crash before a letter is enqueued can still lose it; repeating an event creates new letter IDs and is not deduplicated by per-letter receipts.

Persist/reconstruct phase and remaining duration, castle power/balls/carriers/towers, Sky Garden points and participant records; fence the owning Map. Current reconnect snapshots are not proof of active-war restoration. Test real MapWorker/WorldWorker restarts and cross-Map transitions.

Mercenary-contract cleanup in GuildTacticsAdd still fires its separate applicant deletion without a durable contract/slot transaction. Review both entry points together when introducing settlement/contract recovery. Successful interactive assignment/withdrawal now waits for SQL; this is not a claim that the entire contract lifecycle is atomic.

Verify qualification, signup/caps, entry, gatekeepers, relic handling, power/time victory, rewards, buffs, heroes, guild house, a second event, logout and restart with multiple real clients. Establish compatible official schedules, reward/chart/spawn data; do not invent missing TPVPOINTCHART or TT_WARREGION behavior.

World queues and normal-map relays already exist. The BOW_COMPILE_MODE/BR_COMPILE_MODE match-server gameplay is a separate incomplete port; the four classic territory modes above do not establish completion of every official war/PvP mode.
